backtest_protocol.execution_model: Annual 10-K assets facts are known by SEC filed date (<= signal date) and compared against the prior comparable annual period. Price confirmation uses only signal-date OHLCV. Paper entry is the next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus replay-only broad warehouse default-off paper overlay

runtime_fields: SEC companyfacts canonical assets (annual 10-K instant facts)
SEC companyfacts filed date, period end, and form

gate3.note: No new core filter or entry rule was added. The candidate source is additive default-off paper, so core signals generated/survived are unchanged from baseline.

hypothesis: PIT SEC Companyfacts low annual 10-K asset growth paired with liquid SPY-relative confirmation may identify capital-disciplined leaders and avoid overinvestment losers.
interpretation: The low asset-growth source did not clear Gate 4 (failed: window_ev_regression, window_pnl_regression, drawdown_drift_too_high, accepted_distribution_pnl_not_beaten). Do not promote or tune this fixed asset-growth bundle on the same frozen windows.
next_evidence_needed: A retry needs materially different PIT investment discipline evidence such as asset growth relative to industry peers, capex-free-cash-flow coverage, or closed forward replacement rows. Do not sweep asset-growth thresholds, fact age, price guards, top-N, hold, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.

pre_run_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate_pool: production-universe names whose latest filed annual 10-K total assets grew no more than 10%, and did not contract more than 25%, may avoid overinvestment losers while retaining capital-disciplined leaders when liquid SPY-relative confirmation is present.

2_history_check.exp-20260528-017: Accepted low-liability Companyfacts support; this run compares same-ticker annual total assets through time, not liability level.
2_history_check.exp-20260613-031: Rejected operating-efficiency-assets support; this run does not scale earnings by assets and instead tests annual asset growth.
2_history_check.exp-20260614-020/024/025/027: Cash-conversion, quarterly cash conversion, TTM accruals, and TTM cash-flow acceleration were rejected or drawdown-failing. This run does not retune their ratios, fact age, stops, or thresholds.
2_history_check.exp-20260614-029: Diluted share contraction was rejected. Asset growth is a distinct balance-sheet investment/overinvestment field.
2_history_check.exp-20260615-001: SEC deleveraging text was rejected. This run uses numeric PIT Companyfacts assets and no filing-language classifier.

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must be positive, no window EV/PnL regression, at least two EV-improved windows, at least 20 paper trades across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration pass, and the accepted compression and distribution candidate-pool comparators must be beaten. Replay-only positives are leads until shared daily/backtest parity exists.

prediction.confidence_reason: Low asset growth is a documented free SEC fundamental anomaly and no exact prior asset-growth experiment was found; related Companyfacts quality fields are crowded, so the main risk is overlap with accepted low-liability/RS and generic momentum.

execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing annual 10-K current/prior assets, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same PIT annual 10-K asset-growth gate, liquid SPY-relative confirmation, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.
